name: Atlantic hurricanes since 1851
blurb: Every Atlantic storm in NOAA's HURDAT2 best track, 1851 to 2025: tracks, landfalls by country and state, and each storm's path and winds. Satellites have watched every storm since 1966; compare major hurricanes per season in 1966-1995 with 1996-2025 as the 2026 season closes.
